subject.title: feat(kimi): show code quota in usage status

question: Should OpenClaw automatically poll https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/usages for existing managed Kimi API-key profiles and display the resulting quota windows in status surfaces?
rationale: The code has a bounded implementation and live endpoint evidence, but enabling recurring quota polling with existing credentials is a bundled-provider product and privacy/operational policy choice rather than a mechanical correctness repair.

options.title: Accept managed Kimi quota status
options.body: Merge after a current-main refresh, retaining the managed-origin gate so custom Kimi proxies remain untouched.

options.title: Keep Kimi auth-only
options.body: Decline this feature direction and leave Kimi model access unchanged without automatic quota polling.

recommendation.title: Accept managed Kimi quota status
recommendation.body: Merge after a current-main refresh, retaining the managed-origin gate so custom Kimi proxies remain untouched.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Kimi plugin history makes steipete the strongest available owner for deciding whether this bundled provider should opt into status polling.
